description: Sends the user's reply to one recruiter or employer email, under the user's name, from their GetMattered address (or their connected mailbox, when the thread arrived there). message_id comes from getmattered_get_inbox, which also drafts replies. Without a confirmation form in the client, the first call sends nothing and returns a confirm_token; a second call with that token sends. A sent reply cannot be unsent.

body.description: The exact plain-text reply the user approved, signed with their name.

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of an earlier call that returned confirmation_required, sent after the user said yes to that exact email, with the same arguments. It works once, for 10 minutes.

message_id.description: The message_id of the email to answer, from getmattered_get_inbox. The reply goes to the newest email the employer sent in that conversation.

name: getmattered_reply_to_email

confirmToken.description: With confirmation_required: the confirm_token value that sends this reply, with the same message_id and body, after the user's yes. Works once, for 10 minutes.

sentMessageId.description: The sent reply in the inbox. Null when nothing was sent.

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

status.description: sent: the email went out; not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent; confirmation_required: nothing was sent yet, and the email goes out with confirmToken after the user's yes.

title: Reply to an Employer Email
